parsedVerdict.reasoning: CancelBookingService is a use-case orchestrator, which is the role of the application layer. It loads the aggregate through the BookingRepository port and hands the cancellation rule to the domain via booking.cancel(). It then calls the PaymentGateway, BookingRepository and NotificationSender ports for the refund, persistence and notification side effects, and maps the result to an application view DTO. The file has no persistence, transport or framework code: no SQL, HTTP, ORM or request/response handling. The business rule itself stays in the domain entity. CancelContextDto is a plain application-level DTO. Choosing to refund and notify after a cancellation is workflow coordination, which belongs in an application service, not a misplaced domain invariant. No ADR prose was given that would contradict this.
